# HomeBackupCost

> Independent, source-linked US guide to the cost and sizing of home backup power (portable power stations, whole-home batteries, standby generators, solar backup), plus home energy rebate status by state.

Prices and figures on each page carry their own sources and "as of" dates; check the page for current values.

## Tools
- [Home Backup Power Cost: Battery Size, Price & Rebates](https://homebackupcost.com/): home page with a quick check by ZIP code
- [Backup Power Calculator: kWh, Surge Watts & Runtime](https://homebackupcost.com/calculator/): size a battery or generator from your appliances
- [Power Station vs Generator: Total Outage Cost](https://homebackupcost.com/power-station-vs-generator-cost/): compare upfront and fuel cost over an outage
- [Get Backup Power & Solar Installer Quotes](https://homebackupcost.com/quotes/): installer quote request page
